name: freechains
tagline: An EEE student's log from linear algebra to the Higgs boson — projects, notes and the long road to 125 GeV.
about:
I'm an electrical & electronics engineering student who fell for particle physics. This site is my lab notebook in public: the projects I build on the way to understanding the Higgs boson, and blog posts about what I learn.

Right now I'm working through a 23-week self-study program — linear algebra → quantum mechanics → particle physics → reproducing the Higgs discovery plot from real CERN open data.
